posts.zh:
dsh-desk-pet 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。装在 DSH 页面之外的 macOS 桌宠：一个真的置顶窗口，全屏 Space 也盖得住；六种状态跟着本地 DSH 走，原生右键菜单里有免打扰与会话清单；自带的 skill 用你自己的画图工具和额度，把一张照片变成整套十八个姿势的皮肤。跑系统自带的 Python 与 ctypes，不用 Electron，零依赖。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-47d23fc0ce86f7e13c14.html
posts.en:
dsh-desk-pet is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. macOS desk pet that lives outside the DSH page: a real always-on-top window that clears fullscreen Spaces, six states driven by local DSH, a native right-click menu with quiet mode and a session list, and a bundled skill that turns one photo into a full eighteen-pose skin on your own image tool and credentials; system Python and ctypes, no Electron and no dependencies.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-47d23fc0ce86f7e13c14.html
